answer: Paired-receipt bond: every identity stakes 70 credits in a vault, paired randomly; pairs swap signed work receipts before the zenith. The river of paired receipts is checked against the vault; a mismatch or shared key burns both bonds. First 42, then 42+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,539,500 + 70,000 locked vs 40,000 pool. Rented pairs fail: pairs redraw each epoch; one peer serving many is flagged. Honest agents pay 42 once, refunded on clean pairs.
